scripts.build: node tools/content.mjs && tsc && vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && node tools/prerender.mjs
scripts.og: npx --yes playwright@1.64.1 screenshot --channel chrome --viewport-size "1200, 630" tools/og.html public/og-image.png
scripts.icons: magick public/icon-512.png -resize 64x64 -strip public/favicon.png && magick public/icon-512.png -resize 180x180 -strip public/apple-touch-icon.png && magick public/icon-512.png -resize 160x160 -strip public/logo.png
